title: Deployment Config
description: Per-client deployment configuration for the RAG Knowledge Agent stack. Not versioned — lives in deployments/

clientSlug.description: Short identifier for the client/context (e.g. 'nery', 'al4n', 'eworks'). Used in resource naming.

envName.description: Deployment environment within the client account.

account.description: 12-digit AWS account ID for this deployment.

region.description: AWS region for all stack resources.

resourcePrefix.description: Prefix for all named AWS resources (agent name, API names, bucket names, table names, roles, etc.). Replaces the hardcoded 'rag-knowledge-agent' prefix.

tags.description: Additional tags applied to all stack resources.

supabaseProjectRef.description: Supabase project ref for dual-issuer JWT validation (Lovable Cloud integration). Optional.

knowledgeBase.description: Knowledge Base configuration for this client.

existingKnowledgeBaseId.description: ID of a pre-existing Bedrock Knowledge Base to import (instead of creating new).

existingKnowledgeBaseArn.description: ARN of a pre-existing Bedrock Knowledge Base to import.

agent.description: Bedrock Agent configuration for this client.

modelId.description: Bedrock model ID for the agent.

instructionOverride.description: Override the default agent instruction text.

cognito.description: Cognito User Pool configuration for this client.

domainPrefix.description: Custom domain prefix for the Cognito hosted UI.
